summaries.name: Japanese Alps
summaries.summary: The Japanese Alps span Nagano, Niigata, and Toyama prefectures, connected by the 350-kilometer Japanese Alps Route through valleys, mountains, and traditional villages. Autumn foliage peaks in mid-November, with average temperatures of 10-15°C (50-59°F). The Japanese Alps Visitor Center in Matsumoto provides information on routes and attractions. A trip to the Japanese Alps in November, based in Nagano prefecture, is being planned, with Matsumoto chosen as the accommodation base.

summaries.name: Shinjuku Expressway Bus Terminal
summaries.summary: Shinjuku Expressway Bus Terminal in Tokyo is a departure point for highway buses to Nagano City, with the journey taking around 3-4 hours depending on traffic.

summaries.name: Japan Rail Pass
summaries.summary: The Japan Rail Pass can be cost-effective for travel between Tokyo and Nagano when taking multiple trains during a trip.
